description: This file contains React components and functions for rendering various system messages and post-related UI elements in Mattermost, including message formatting, user mentions, channel and team updates, and system notifications.

methods.name: renderUsername
methods.description: Renders a username with an '@' prefix, ensuring the input is a string.

methods.name: renderFormattedText
methods.description: Renders formatted markdown text with optional options and post context.

methods.name: renderJoinChannelMessage
methods.description: Returns a ReactNode indicating a user joined a channel.

methods.name: renderGuestJoinChannelMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a guest joined a channel, optionally hiding guest tags.

methods.name: renderLeaveChannelMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a user left a channel.

methods.name: renderAddToChannelMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a user was added to a channel.

methods.name: renderAddGuestToChannelMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a guest was added to a channel.

methods.name: renderRemoveFromChannelMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a user was removed from a channel.

methods.name: renderJoinTeamMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a user joined a team.

methods.name: renderLeaveTeamMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a user left a team.

methods.name: renderAddToTeamMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a user was added to a team.

methods.name: renderRemoveFromTeamMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a user was removed from a team.

methods.name: renderHeaderChangeMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the channel header was changed.

methods.name: renderDisplayNameChangeMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the display name of a channel was changed.

methods.name: renderConvertChannelToPrivateMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a channel was converted from public to private.

methods.name: renderPurposeChangeMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the channel purpose was changed.

methods.name: renderChannelDeletedMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a channel was archived.

methods.name: renderChannelUnarchivedMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a channel was unarchived.

methods.name: renderAutoTranslationChangeMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating auto-translation was enabled or disabled for a channel.

methods.name: renderMeMessage
methods.description: Returns a /me message after trimming asterisks.

methods.name: renderSystemMessage
methods.description: Main function to render various system messages based on post type and context.

methods.name: renderReminderACKMessage
methods.description: Renders a reminder acknowledgment message with time and date formatting.

methods.name: renderReminderSystemBotMessage
methods.description: Renders a system bot message for reminders.

methods.name: renderWranglerSystemMessage
methods.description: Renders system messages related to thread moving and other server-side actions.

methods.name: isAddMemberProps
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value conforms to AddMemberProps structure.
